Everything isn't for everyone. I too have really sensitive skin and this stuff works like a charm. If you're breaking out after use, that's because you didn't follow the instructions. Always spot test and wait 48-72 hours for a reaction. You can even try using it in your routine several times a week instead of daily because this stuff actually works and it's cheaper than a cup of coffee. I've had deep deep hyperpigmentation in the corners of my mouth for 20+ years and it's lightened it up 60% or so in less than a year. I actually like looking in a mirror now and don't hate taking selfies or wearing lipstick now. Besides if it burns your skin, that's a YOU problem because YOUR allergic, it's not a failing of the product and shouldn't be used as a scare-tatic to keep people away from a product that actually does work! SPOT TEST!
